number_tolerance.description: Numbers closer than this are treated as equal. Default 0.

bibliography.description: Raw BibTeX / RIS / CSL-JSON text (provide this OR claims). Capped at 25 entries; the excess is dropped and counted in `truncated`.

checks.description: Per-entry checks. Default ['retraction']; pass [] to skip.

claims.description: Pre-parsed citations (provide this OR bibliography). Each needs `title` plus whatever identifiers it carries (doi, pmid, pmcid, isbn, arxiv, issn, ads, whoIrisUrl), optionally author / year / container.

tools.name: admintoolkit_analyze_email_headers
tools.description: Return a read-only email message header report. Accepts pasted RFC 5322 headers. Includes raw Received order, recorded Authentication-Results and caller-configured authserv-id trust; it does not perform cryptographic authentication or reverse-DNS verification.

headers.description: Full email headers to analyze, e.g. 'Authentication-Results: ...'.

trusted_authserv_ids.description: Optional authserv-id values explicitly trusted by the caller; without them, Authentication-Results remain unverified recorded claims.

tools.name: admintoolkit_analyze_http_headers
tools.description: Return a read-only HTTP response-header report for a public endpoint. Accepts pasted headers or a public URL. Includes security, cache, framing, duplicate/conflicting header fields, prioritized findings and remediation notes.

headers.description: Pasted HTTP response headers, e.g. 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000'.

url.description: Public URL to fetch for HTTP header analysis, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_calculate_cidr_subnet
tools.description: Return a read-only local IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR report. Accepts a CIDR block plus optional split prefix and address family. Includes exact BigInt-derived boundaries and address counts, RFC 3021 /31 and host-route /32 semantics, no IPv6 broadcast claim, embedded-IPv4 parsing and a capped subnet preview.

target.description: Split target prefix length, e.g. '26' for /26 subnets.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Return a read-only RFC 9309 robots.txt access report for AI and search crawlers. Accepts robots.txt text or a public robots.txt URL plus an optional path. Includes merged matching groups, octet-normalized longest-match decisions, per-crawler evidence, transport status, crawler-registry provenance and policy snippets.

content.description: Pasted robots.txt content to validate locally, e.g. 'User-agent: GPTBot'.

crawlers.description: Crawler tokens to evaluate as an array, e.g. ['GPTBot','Google-Extended'].

path.description: Path to evaluate against robots.txt rules, e.g. '/' or '/tools/'.

url.description: Robots.txt URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/robots.txt'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_bimi_record
tools.description: Return a read-only BIMI readiness report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain, selector and optional BIMI, DMARC, logo or certificate evidence. Includes TXT syntax, DMARC dependency, asset URL findings and a conservative BIMI draft.

dmarc.description: Pasted DMARC TXT record for BIMI policy review, e.g. 'v=DMARC1; p=reject'.

evidence_url.description: BIMI VMC or evidence URL to inspect, e.g. 'https://example.com/vmc.pem'.

logo_url.description: BIMI SVG logo URL to inspect, e.g. 'https://example.com/logo.svg'.

record.description: Pasted BIMI TXT record, e.g. 'v=BIMI1; l=https://example.com/logo.svg'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_caa_records
tools.description: Return a read-only CAA certificate-authority policy report for a domain. Accepts a domain plus optional CAA records and issuer details. Includes issue, issuewild, iodef, ACME parameters, policy gaps and record-generation guidance.

ca.description: CA domain for generated CAA records, e.g. 'letsencrypt.org'.

domain.description: CAA domain to check, e.g. 'example.com' (no scheme).

issuemail.description: CAA issuemail issuer-domain value from RFC 9495, optionally followed by issuer parameters, e.g. 'letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01'.

records.description: CAA records to inspect, one per line, e.g. '0 issue letsencrypt.org'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_email_auth_records
tools.description: Return a read-only SPF, DMARC and DKIM report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional pasted TXT values. Includes syntax, policy strength, alignment, DNS evidence and record-specific warnings.

dkim_record.description: Pasted DKIM TXT value, e.g. 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...'.

dmarc_record.description: Pasted DMARC TXT record, e.g. 'v=DMARC1; p=reject'.

selector.description: DKIM selector to query, e.g. 's1' or 'default'.

spf_record.description: Pasted SPF TXT record, e.g. 'v=spf1 redirect=spf.example.com'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_mta_sts_policy
tools.description: Return a read-only MTA-STS deployment report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional TXT, policy, MX and TLS-RPT evidence. Includes mode, max-age, syntax, id consistency, MX coverage, conformance findings and remediation warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain for MTA-STS checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

mode.description: Generated MTA-STS policy mode: 'testing', 'enforce', or 'none', e.g. 'testing'.

mx_hosts.description: Known MX hostnames, one per line, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

policy.description: Pasted MTA-STS policy text, e.g. 'version: STSv1'.

tls_rpt.description: Pasted TLS-RPT TXT value, e.g. 'v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tls@example.com'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_mx_records
tools.description: Return a read-only MX routing report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain name. Includes exchanger hosts, preferences, Null MX, CNAME risk, address resolution and actionable mail-routing warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain to check via DNS MX lookup, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_redirect_indexability
tools.description: Return a read-only redirect, canonical and indexability report for a public URL. Accepts a URL. Includes bounded per-hop status and SSRF evidence, final URL, HTML and HTTP canonical hints, robots meta and scoped X-Robots-Tag directives, hreflang, separate sitemap reachability and membership, and evidence completeness.

url.description: Public URL to check for redirects and indexability, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_smtp_tls_readiness
tools.description: Return a read-only SMTP TLS delivery readiness report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain and optional MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE and FCrDNS checks. Includes MX, STARTTLS, certificate, policy-alignment and downgrade-risk findings.

check_dane.description: Include DANE/TLSA checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_fcrdns.description: Include forward-confirmed reverse DNS checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_mta_sts.description: Include MTA-STS checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_tls_rpt.description: Include TLS-RPT checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

domain.description: Mail domain for SMTP TLS readiness checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_tls_configuration
tools.description: Return a read-only public TLS configuration report for a host. Accepts host and port plus optional HSTS evidence. Includes separate exact-version probes, a distinct verified default handshake, SAN identity/trust evidence, negotiated cipher and ALPN evidence, and HTTPS-only HSTS checks; it does not claim cipher or ALPN enumeration.

host.description: Public TLS DNS host or IP literal to check, e.g. 'example.com' or '1.1.1.1' (no scheme; private/reserved targets are rejected).

hsts.description: Optional pasted HSTS header, e.g. 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.

port.description: TLS port number to check, e.g. '443'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_check_tls_rpt_policy
tools.description: Return a read-only SMTP TLS Reporting report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional TLS-RPT TXT or RUA values. Includes version syntax, reporting destinations, external-provider use, conformance findings and remediation warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain for TLS-RPT checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_decode_edid_data
tools.description: Return a read-only share-safe local EDID capability report. Includes strict hex or local file text decoding, checksum and trust state, a readable timing/VIC/Y420 matrix, CTA audio and speaker topology, qualified HDMI Forum transport, HDR and DisplayID evidence, coverage and byte provenance. WebMCP omits display identifiers, serials, filenames, physical addresses, raw bytes and vendor payload values; it does not infer Atmos, DTS:X, HDMI certification, cable capability or source mode selection.

edid_hex.description: Pasted strict EDID hexadecimal text, e.g. '00ffffffffffff00...'.

file.description: Local EDID file content represented as strict hexadecimal text; binary file selection is available in the visible browser UI.

tools.name: admintoolkit_decode_ssl_certificate
tools.description: Return a read-only X.509 TLS certificate report. Accepts PEM text or public TLS host details. Includes subject, issuer, SANs, validity, fingerprints, key usage, extensions, hostname and certificate-health findings.

host.description: TLS certificate host to connect to, e.g. 'example.com'.

pem.description: Certificate PEM text to decode, e.g. '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_generate_tlsa_record
tools.description: Return a read-only DANE TLSA record report. Accepts host, port, protocol, usage, selector, matching type and optional certificate data. Includes owner name, digest, generated TLSA data and DNS comparison findings.

file.description: Certificate file content to parse, e.g. PEM text from a .crt file.

host.description: TLS service host for TLSA generation, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

pem.description: Certificate PEM, DER base64, or hex input, e.g. '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----'.

port.description: TLS service port number, e.g. '25' or '443'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_show_public_ip_context
tools.description: Return a read-only same-origin IP context report for the current request. Requires no input. Includes the canonical primary address, directly observed peer, trusted-proxy decision, preserved forwarded-header claims and observed address family; one request path does not prove dual-stack capability and no third-party Geo-IP lookup is performed.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_a2a_agent_card
tools.description: Return a read-only version-aware A2A Agent Card validation report. Includes v0.2, v0.3 and v1.0 structure plus discovery-path evidence without claiming endpoint, authentication or signature conformance.

json.description: Pasted Agent Card JSON to validate locally, e.g. '{"name":"Agent"}'.

url.description: Agent Card URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_arc_chain
tools.description: Return a read-only ARC structural validation report. Accepts pasted ARC-Seal, ARC-Message-Signature and ARC-Authentication-Results fields. Includes structural completeness, instance continuity and recorded cv state; cryptographic validation and sealer trust are not evaluated.

headers.description: Message headers containing ARC fields, e.g. 'ARC-Seal: i=1; ...'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_dane_records
tools.description: Return a read-only DANE service validation report. Accepts service host, port, protocol, TLSA records, DNSSEC status and optional certificate evidence. Includes owner names, TLSA syntax, DNSSEC dependency and certificate-match findings.

host.description: DANE service host to validate, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

port.description: DANE service port number, e.g. '25' or '443'.

tlsa_records.description: TLSA records to validate, one per line, e.g. '3 1 1 <sha256>'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_dnssec_records
tools.description: Return a read-only DNSSEC evidence report for a domain. Accepts a domain plus optional DS, DNSKEY, RRSIG and resolver-status data. Includes chain readiness, algorithms, missing records, validation findings and warnings.

dnskey_records.description: DNSKEY records for the zone, one per line, e.g. '257 3 13 <key>'.

ds_records.description: DS records for the domain, one per line, e.g. '12345 13 2 <digest>'.

rrsig_records.description: RRSIG records for validation context, one per line, e.g. 'example.com. RRSIG ...'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Validate the required initial H1, optional summary and project details, and any H2 resource lists with link titles, URLs, optional descriptions, findings, and source-line evidence.

content.description: Pasted llms.txt Markdown content to validate locally, e.g. '# Example'.

detail.description: Optional response size: 'compact' (default) returns findings, counts, section summaries and bounded link evidence; 'full' also returns the raw llms.txt source and the complete per-section and per-link document model, e.g. 'full'.

url.description: llms.txt URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/llms.txt'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_security_txt
tools.description: Return a read-only RFC 9116 security.txt report. Accepts pasted content or a public security.txt URL plus optional contact fields. Includes contact, expiry, canonical, encryption, policy, language fields, findings and draft output.

url.description: Public security.txt URL or bare domain, e.g. 'https://example.com/.well-known/security.txt'.

tools.name: admintoolkit_validate_webmcp_tool
tools.description: Return a read-only WebMCP report for pasted or fetched source. Includes declarative and imperative static-source evidence separately from caller-provided runtime observation; pasted JavaScript is never executed and active runtime tools are never inferred from source alone.

detail.description: Optional response size: 'compact' (default) returns findings, counts and static-source evidence; 'full' also returns the complete fetched page text in metadata.text, e.g. 'full'.

source.description: Pasted HTML or JavaScript source to validate locally, e.g. 'data-tool-name=demo'.

url.description: Public page URL to fetch for WebMCP validation, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: convert_3d_to_gltf
tools.description: Convert a 3D scene (FBX, OBJ, DAE, PLY, STL, GLTF, GLB, 3DS, LWO, BLEND, X, MS3D, ASE) to glTF 2.0 or binary GLB, entirely in the browser. Native magnum-plugins importers handle the mainstream formats (ufbx for FBX/OBJ, GltfImporter for glTF/GLB, StanfordImporter for PLY, StlImporter for STL, OpenGexImporter for OGEX); Assimp is the fallback for the long tail (DAE, 3DS, LWO, BLEND, X, …). Output is written by Magnum's GltfSceneConverter. Optional MeshOptimizer pass re-encodes meshes for the GPU vertex cache and can simplify them by a target ratio. Lazy-loads the matching WASM module per family.

fileName.description: Original filename; the extension is used to pick the importer.

optimize.description: Run MeshOptimizer vertex-cache / overdraw / vertex-fetch passes on every mesh.

outputFormat.description: glTF (JSON + embedded buffers) or GLB (single compact binary). Defaults to gltf.

simplifyRatio.description: Fraction of triangles to KEEP, 0..1. 0 or 1 disables simplification.
